translations.idiomatic: In the third year he led his fleet to guard Tongzhou, by which time Jiangning had been pacified.

sentences.zh: 四年，赴九江鎮任。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he went to take up his post at the Jiujiang garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he took up his post at the Jiujiang garrison.

sentences.zh: 十年，卒，諡剛愍。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he died; he was posthumously given the temple name Gangmin.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he died and was posthumously honored with the temple name Gangmin.

sentences.zh: 陳國瑞，字慶雲，湖北應城人。

translations.literal: Chen Guorui, styled Qingyun, was a native of Yingcheng in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Guorui, styled Qingyun, came from Yingcheng in Hubei.

sentences.zh: 年十餘歲陷賊中，出投總兵黃開榜，收為義子，冒姓黃氏。

translations.literal: When he was little more than ten he fell among the rebels; he escaped and joined regional commander Huang Kaibang, who adopted him as a foster son and he took the surname Huang.
translations.idiomatic: While still in his early teens he was caught up among the rebels; he escaped and joined regional commander Huang Kaibang, who adopted him as a foster son and gave him the surname Huang.

sentences.zh: 在軍每戰衝鋒。

translations.literal: In the army he charged at the front in every battle.
translations.idiomatic: In every battle he led the charge.

sentences.zh: 咸豐九年，從攻懷遠，率七人夜渡河攀堞先登，擲火燔譙樓，斬悍賊十餘人，師畢登，遂克懷遠，自是以勇聞。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Xianfeng, in the attack on Huaiyuan, he led seven men to cross the river by night, climb the parapet, and scale first; they cast fire and burned the gate tower, cut down more than ten fierce rebels, the main force all mounted the wall, and Huaiyuan was taken; from then on he became known for courage.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Xianfeng, during the assault on Huaiyuan, he led seven men across the river by night, climbed the wall first, and set fire to the gate tower. They killed more than ten fierce rebels, the main force followed over the wall, and Huaiyuan fell. From then on he was famed for bravery.

sentences.zh: 欽差大臣袁甲三進圍定遠，捻首李光等來援，國瑞陷陣，脅中槍，裹創力戰，賊辟易，乘勝破二圩，賜號技勇巴圖魯。

translations.literal: Imperial Commissioner Yuan Jiasan advanced to besiege Dingyuan; Nian chiefs Li Guang and others came to the relief; Guorui fell into the battle line, was shot in the side, bound his wound and fought fiercely; the rebels gave way; taking advantage of victory he stormed two stockades; he was granted the title Jiyong Batu'eru.
translations.idiomatic: When Imperial Commissioner Yuan Jiasan besieged Dingyuan, Nian chiefs including Li Guang came to the relief. Guorui plunged into the fight, was shot in the side, bound his wound, and kept fighting until the rebels gave way. Pressing the advantage, he stormed two stockades and was awarded the title Jiyong Batooru.

sentences.zh: 奉檄援壽州，中途聞賊犯鳳陽，回軍夜往，連破賊壘，立解圍，超擢游擊。

translations.literal: Ordered on relief to Shouzhou, halfway he heard the rebels were attacking Fengyang, turned his army around and went by night, successively stormed rebel forts, lifted the siege at once, and was promoted by special appointment to brigade commander.
translations.idiomatic: Ordered to relieve Shouzhou, he heard midway that rebels were attacking Fengyang, turned back by night, stormed rebel forts in succession, lifted the siege at once, and was specially promoted to brigade commander.

sentences.zh: 十一年，江、皖賊合眾窺揚州，國瑞馳剿湖西，屢破賊，加副將銜。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year rebels from Jiangsu and Anhui combined to watch for an opening at Yangzhou; Guorui hurried to suppress them west of the lake, repeatedly defeated them, and was granted the rank of deputy commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Jiangsu and Anhui rebels massed to threaten Yangzhou; Guorui hurried west of the lake to suppress them, defeated them repeatedly, and was granted the rank of deputy commander.

sentences.zh: 同治元年春，捻匪犯淮安，國瑞率五百人繞出賊後，與總兵龔耀倫夾擊，賊驚潰，馬賊悉遁，步賊萬餘回拒，國瑞偕總兵王萬清合戰破之。

translations.literal: In the spring of the first year of Tongzhi, Nian bandits attacked Huai'an; Guorui led five hundred men in a detour behind the rebels and, with regional commander Gong Yaolun in a pincer attack, the rebels fled in panic; the mounted rebels all fled; more than ten thousand foot rebels turned to resist; Guorui together with regional commander Wang Wanqing joined battle and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the first year of Tongzhi, when Nian bandits attacked Huai'an, Guorui led five hundred men around behind the enemy and, with regional commander Gong Yaolun, struck in a pincer. The rebels broke in panic; the cavalry fled, but more than ten thousand foot soldiers turned to fight back. Guorui and regional commander Wang Wanqing joined forces and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 再破賊黨李城於版徬。

translations.literal: He again defeated the rebel faction under Li Cheng at Banfang.
translations.idiomatic: He again defeated Li Cheng's rebel band at Banfang.

sentences.zh: 賊由眾興集撲清江浦，擊走之。

translations.literal: Rebels from Zhongxingji rushed on Qingjiangpu; he drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: When rebels from Zhongxingji struck at Qingjiangpu, he drove them back.

sentences.zh: 以砲船三十遏運河，夜襲桃源北岸，破賊圩四，直取眾興，拔十餘壘，擢副將。

translations.literal: With thirty gunboats he blocked the Grand Canal, made a night attack on the north bank of Taoyuan, stormed four rebel stockades, pressed straight on Zhongxing, captured more than ten forts, and was promoted to deputy commander.
translations.idiomatic: With thirty gunboats he blocked the Grand Canal, raided the north bank of Taoyuan by night, took four rebel stockades, pushed on to Zhongxing, and captured more than ten forts; he was promoted to deputy commander.

sentences.zh: 三月，率步卒八百敗賊於涇河，轉戰至新河，賊逼堤而陣。

translations.literal: In the third month he led eight hundred foot soldiers to defeat rebels at the Jing River, fought on to Xinhe, and the rebels pressed close to the dike in battle formation.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month he led eight hundred foot soldiers to defeat rebels at the Jing River and fought on to Xinhe, where the rebels drew up tight against the dike.

sentences.zh: 國瑞麾隊猛進，手燃砲殪執旗賊目，斬級千餘，以總兵記名。

translations.literal: Guorui commanded his unit in a fierce advance, personally fired a cannon and killed the rebel standard-bearer, beheaded more than a thousand, and was placed on the list for regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: Guorui drove his men forward in a fierce assault, personally fired a cannon and killed the rebel standard-bearer, and took more than a thousand heads; he was placed on the list for regional commander.

sentences.zh: 進剿泗州捻首韓老萬，敗之。

translations.literal: Advancing to suppress Nian chief Han Laowan of Sizhou, he defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced against Nian chief Han Laowan of Sizhou and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 四月，戰於邳州新村，捻眾亙三十里，國瑞分三路迎擊，斬賊渠王春玉，擲其首賊陣中，賊駭亂，夜冒雨襲破其三營。

translations.literal: In the fourth month he fought at Xincun in Pizhou; the Nian masses stretched for thirty li; Guorui divided into three routes to meet the attack, beheaded the rebel chieftain Wang Chunyu, and threw his head into the rebel battle line; the rebels were terrified and thrown into disorder; at night in the rain he launched a surprise attack and stormed three of their camps.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month he fought at Xincun in Pizhou, where the Nian ranks stretched thirty li. Guorui split his force into three columns, beheaded rebel chieftain Wang Chunyu, and hurled the head into the enemy lines. The rebels panicked, and that night, in the rain, he stormed three of their camps.

sentences.zh: 別賊趨救，昏暗不辨，自相殺，乘勢蹙之，殲數千。

translations.literal: Another band of rebels rushed to the rescue; in the darkness they could not distinguish friend from foe and killed one another; he seized the advantage and pressed them, annihilating several thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Another rebel band rushed to the rescue, but in the darkness they could not tell friend from foe and turned on one another. Guorui pressed the advantage and wiped out several thousand.

sentences.zh: 捻勢遂衰。

translations.literal: Nian strength thus declined.
translations.idiomatic: The Nian cause thus waned.

sentences.zh: 時山東棍、幅各匪麕集郯城，漕運總督吳棠檄國瑞進剿，連克數圩，斃悍酋孫化祥，餘黨多就撫。

translations.literal: At that time stick- and banner-bandits of various kinds from Shandong were massed at Tancheng; Grand Canal Director Wu Tang ordered Guorui to advance in suppression; he successively captured several stockades, killed the fierce chief Sun Huaxiang, and many of the remaining followers submitted.
translations.idiomatic: At that time stick- and banner-bandits from Shandong had massed at Tancheng. Grand Canal Director Wu Tang ordered Guorui to suppress them; he took several stockades in succession, killed the fierce chief Sun Huaxiang, and many of the survivors submitted.

sentences.zh: 五月，會攻兗州鳳凰山，約副將郭寶昌、參將康錦文分路設伏，躬率小隊抵白蓮池，誘賊出，伏發，截賊隊為二，擒悍匪劉雙印。

translations.literal: In the fifth month they jointly attacked Fenghuang Mountain at Yanzhou; he arranged with deputy commander Guo Baochang and battalion commander Kang Jinwen to set ambushes by separate routes; he personally led a small squad to White Lotus Pool, lured the rebels out, the ambush struck, cut the rebel column in two, and captured the fierce bandit Liu Shuangyin.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month they jointly attacked Fenghuang Mountain at Yanzhou. Guorui arranged with deputy commander Guo Baochang and battalion commander Kang Jinwen to lay ambushes on separate routes, then personally led a small squad to White Lotus Pool to draw the rebels out. When the ambush struck, the rebel column was cut in two and the fierce bandit Liu Shuangyin was captured.

sentences.zh: 緣崖先登，諸軍繼之，克鳳凰山，戮逆首宋維鵬等，賜黃馬褂、頭品頂戴。

translations.literal: He scaled the cliff first; the other armies followed; they captured Fenghuang Mountain, executed the rebel leaders including Song Weipeng, and he was granted a yellow riding jacket and first-rank cap button.
translations.idiomatic: He was first up the cliff, the other units followed, and Fenghuang Mountain fell. The rebel leaders, including Song Weipeng, were executed, and Guorui was granted a yellow riding jacket and first-rank cap button.

sentences.zh: 國瑞呈請歸宗，复陳姓。

translations.literal: Guorui petitioned to return to his original clan and resumed the surname Chen.
translations.idiomatic: Guorui petitioned to rejoin his birth clan and resumed the surname Chen.

sentences.zh: 會苗沛霖叛，僧格林沁移剿，檄國瑞先發，漕運總督吳棠奏請國瑞幫辦軍務。

translations.literal: When Miao Peilin rebelled, Senggelinqin shifted to suppress him, ordered Guorui to advance first, and Grand Canal Director Wu Tang memorialized requesting Guorui be appointed assistant in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When Miao Peilin rebelled, Senggelinqin turned to suppress him, ordered Guorui to move out first, and Grand Canal Director Wu Tang memorialized asking that Guorui be appointed to assist in military affairs.

sentences.zh: 國瑞至蒙城，先襲破紅裡賊圩以通糧道，繼克王圩，越重壕進逼賊巢。

translations.literal: Guorui reached Mengcheng, first made a surprise attack and stormed the rebel stockade at Hongli to open the grain route, then captured Wang stockade, crossed deep moats, and pressed close to the rebel nest.
translations.idiomatic: Guorui reached Mengcheng, first stormed the rebel stockade at Hongli in a surprise attack to open the supply line, then took Wang stockade, crossed deep moats, and pressed on the rebel stronghold.

sentences.zh: 皖軍總兵宋慶會攻，國瑞以賊壘連屬不易下，密令郭寶昌自全家集鳧水支浮橋，宋慶守之，親引軍渡河焚賊糧屯，連破數壘。

translations.literal: Anhui Army regional commander Song Qing joined the attack; Guorui, finding the rebel forts connected and hard to take, secretly ordered Guo Baochang to build a pontoon bridge across a branch of the Fushui from Quanjiaji, Song Qing held it, and he personally led troops across the river to burn rebel grain stores and successively stormed several forts.
translations.idiomatic: Anhui Army regional commander Song Qing joined the assault. Finding the rebel forts linked together and hard to crack, Guorui secretly ordered Guo Baochang to throw a pontoon bridge across a branch of the Fushui from Quanjiaji, which Song Qing held, while he personally led troops across the river to burn rebel grain stores and stormed several forts in succession.

sentences.zh: 沛霖夜遁，為人所殺。

translations.literal: Peilin fled by night and was killed by others.
translations.idiomatic: Peilin fled by night and was killed.

sentences.zh: 淮甸平，以提督記名。

translations.literal: The Huai region was pacified; he was placed on the list for provincial commander.
translations.idiomatic: After the Huai region was pacified, he was placed on the list for promotion to provincial commander.

sentences.zh: 三年，授浙江處州鎮總兵，屯正陽關。

translations.literal: In the third year he was appointed regional commander of the Chuzhou garrison in Zhejiang and stationed at Zhengyang Pass.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was appointed regional commander of the Chuzhou garrison in Zhejiang and stationed at Zhengyang Pass.

sentences.zh: 僧格林沁剿捻湖北不利，檄國瑞赴援，坐遷延，降三級調用，奪所部隸郭寶昌。

translations.literal: When Senggelinqin's suppression of the Nian in Hubei went poorly, he ordered Guorui to come to the relief; for delay he was demoted three grades and reassigned, and his troops were taken away and placed under Guo Baochang.
translations.idiomatic: When Senggelinqin's campaign against the Nian in Hubei faltered, he summoned Guorui to the relief. Guorui was demoted three grades and reassigned for delay, and his command was transferred to Guo Baochang.

sentences.zh: 國瑞觖望，人言其將反。

translations.literal: Guorui nursed resentment, and people said he would rebel.
translations.idiomatic: Guorui brooded over the slight, and rumors spread that he would rebel.

sentences.zh: 八月，國瑞率千餘人謁僧格林沁於光山，請為前鋒，偕翼長成保等剿柳林大小諸寨。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Guorui led more than a thousand men to call on Senggelinqin at Guangshan, requested to serve as vanguard, and together with wing commander Cheng Bao and others suppressed the large and small stockades at Liulin.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Guorui led more than a thousand men to see Senggelinqin at Guangshan, asked to serve as vanguard, and with wing commander Cheng Bao and others suppressed the stockades large and small at Liulin.

sentences.zh: 深入失利，國瑞力戰兩晝夜，始突圍出。

translations.literal: Having advanced deep they met defeat; Guorui fought fiercely for two days and nights before breaking out of the encirclement.
translations.idiomatic: They advanced too far and were defeated; Guorui fought hard for two days and nights before breaking out.

sentences.zh: 追賊蘄水、蘄州、羅田、廣濟，屢捷。

translations.literal: Pursuing the rebels through Qishui, Qizhou, Luotian, and Guangji, he won repeated victories.
translations.idiomatic: Pursuing the rebels through Qishui, Qizhou, Luotian, and Guangji, he won victory after victory.

sentences.zh: 賊竄英山、霍山，合諸軍戰於土漠河，殲斃數千，生擒數百。

translations.literal: The rebels fled into Yingshan and Huoshan; joining with the other armies he fought at Tumu River, killed several thousand, and captured several hundred alive.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled into Yingshan and Huoshan; joining the other armies he fought at Tumu River, killed several thousand, and took several hundred prisoners.

sentences.zh: 時群賊因江寧已克，降散過半。

translations.literal: At that time the bandits, because Jiangning had already been taken, had more than half surrendered and dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: By then Jiangning had fallen, and more than half the bandits had surrendered or scattered.

sentences.zh: 敘功，復原官。

translations.literal: Recording merit, his original rank was restored.
translations.idiomatic: When merit was recorded, his original rank was restored.

sentences.zh: 四年正月，翼長恆齡追賊至魯山，遇伏，與副都統舒倫保等同日陣亡，國瑞力扼橋口，餘眾得還。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year wing commander Hengling pursued rebels to Lushan, met an ambush, and on the same day fell in battle together with Vice Commander-in-Chief Shulunbao and others; Guorui held the bridge pass with all his strength and the remaining troops were able to return.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year wing commander Hengling pursued rebels to Lushan, walked into an ambush, and fell on the same day with Vice Commander-in-Chief Shulunbao and others. Guorui held the bridge pass with all his strength and brought the survivors back.

sentences.zh: 賊犯襄城，國瑞乘夜大雪，出賊不意，火其壘，賊潰定。

translations.literal: Rebels attacked Xiangcheng; Guorui took advantage of a heavy snow at night, caught the rebels unawares, burned their fort, and the rebels fled in rout.
translations.idiomatic: When rebels attacked Xiangcheng, Guorui used a night of heavy snow to catch them by surprise, burned their fort, and put them to rout.

sentences.zh: 時賊被剿急，來往飄忽，僧格林沁率騎軍窮追，國瑞步隊從其後。

translations.literal: At that time the rebels, pressed hard by the campaign, came and went elusively; Senggelinqin led cavalry in relentless pursuit and Guorui's foot troops followed behind.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels, harried by the campaign, darted back and forth; Senggelinqin led cavalry in relentless pursuit with Guorui's foot soldiers trailing behind.

sentences.zh: 三月，遇賊於確山，與諸軍合擊，大破之。

translations.literal: In the third month they met the rebels at Queshan; joining with the other armies in a combined attack, they inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month they met the rebels at Queshan and, joining the other armies in a combined assault, routed them.

sentences.zh: 賊僅餘馬隊，由遂平、西平直走睢州，過舊黃河，入山東境。

translations.literal: The rebels had only their mounted force left; they went straight through Suiping and Xiping toward Suizhou, crossed the old Yellow River, and entered Shandong territory.
translations.idiomatic: Only the rebel cavalry remained; they raced through Suiping and Xiping toward Suizhou, crossed the old Yellow River, and entered Shandong.

sentences.zh: 僧格林沁以國瑞與郭寶昌戰最力，奏賞所部軍士各銀五千兩，又請獎寶昌遇提督簡放。

translations.literal: Senggelinqin, because Guorui and Guo Baochang had fought most fiercely, memorialized that each soldier of their units be rewarded with five thousand taels of silver, and also requested that Baochang be recommended for selection as provincial commander when a vacancy arose.
translations.idiomatic: Senggelinqin reported that Guorui and Guo Baochang had fought hardest, asked that each man in their units be rewarded with five thousand taels of silver, and recommended Baochang for appointment as provincial commander when a post opened.

sentences.zh: 詔謂國瑞確山之戰最出力，命酌量保奏。

translations.literal: An edict said Guorui had exerted himself most in the battle at Queshan and ordered that recommendations be made as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared that Guorui had done the most at Queshan and ordered that he be recommended for reward as appropriate.

sentences.zh: 賊從台莊渡運河，遂趨江北，國瑞躡之，屯沭陽。

translations.literal: The rebels crossed the Grand Canal at Taizhuang and then headed toward Jiangbei; Guorui followed in their tracks and encamped at Shuyang.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels crossed the Grand Canal at Taizhuang and headed for Jiangbei; Guorui followed on their heels and encamped at Shuyang.

sentences.zh: 四月，賊复折入山東，僧格林沁戰於曹州，兵挫遇害。

translations.literal: In the fourth month the rebels again turned back into Shandong; Senggelinqin fought at Caozhou, suffered a setback, and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month the rebels turned back into Shandong; Senggelinqin fought at Caozhou, his force was beaten, and he was killed.

sentences.zh: 詔罪諸將不能救護，國瑞以受傷免議。

translations.literal: An edict blamed the generals for failing to protect him; Guorui was exempted from discussion because he was wounded.
translations.idiomatic: An edict blamed the generals for failing to protect him; Guorui was excused because he had been wounded.

sentences.zh: 素恃功桀驁，自僧格林沁外，罕聽節制。

translations.literal: He had always relied on his merit and was arrogant and insubordinate; apart from Senggelinqin, he rarely obeyed anyone's command.
translations.idiomatic: He had long relied on his record and was proud and insubordinate; apart from Senggelinqin, he seldom obeyed anyone's orders.

sentences.zh: 曾國籓奉命督師，諭戒甚切，飭赴援歸德。

translations.literal: Zeng Guofan was ordered to take command as supervising general; he was sternly admonished and ordered to hurry to relieve Guide.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan was ordered to take overall command; Guorui was sternly warned and ordered to hurry to relieve Guide.

sentences.zh: 至濟寧，與劉銘傳交惡，發兵爭鬥，殺傷甚多，踞長溝相持不下，詔嚴斥之，亦未加之罪。

translations.literal: When he reached Jining he fell out with Liu Mingchuan; they deployed troops and fought; casualties were heavy; they held Changgou in a stalemate; an edict sharply rebuked them but still did not punish him.
translations.idiomatic: At Jining he quarreled with Liu Mingchuan; their troops clashed with heavy casualties, and both sides held Changgou in a stalemate. An edict sharply rebuked them, but still imposed no punishment.

sentences.zh: 國籓疏論：「曹州之役，國瑞與郭寶昌分統左右兩翼，寶昌革職拏問，國瑞不應倖免。

translations.literal: Zeng Guofan memorialized: "In the battle at Caozhou, Guorui and Guo Baochang each commanded one wing; Baochang was dismissed and arrested, and Guorui should not escape lightly."
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan memorialized: "At Caozhou, Guorui and Guo Baochang commanded the left and right wings respectively. Baochang was dismissed and arrested; Guorui should not go unpunished."

sentences.zh: 」遂撤去幫辦軍務，褫黃馬褂，暫留處州鎮戴罪立功。

translations.literal: He was then removed from assisting in military affairs, stripped of his yellow riding jacket, and temporarily retained at the Chuzhou garrison to atone through merit.
translations.idiomatic: He was removed from assisting in military affairs, stripped of his yellow riding jacket, and kept at the Chuzhou garrison to redeem himself through service.

sentences.zh: 尋養病淮安，益縱恣不法，欲殺義子振邦。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he went to Huai'an to recuperate from illness, became even more unrestrained and lawless, and sought to kill his foster son Zhenbang.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he went to Huai'an to convalesce, grew even more unruly and lawless, and tried to kill his foster son Zhenbang.

sentences.zh: 漕運總督吳棠劾其病癲，褫職，押送回籍，收其鹽本、田產充公；

translations.literal: Grand Canal Director Wu Tang impeached him for feigned madness; he was dismissed from office, escorted back to his native place, and his salt capital and land holdings were confiscated;
translations.idiomatic: Grand Canal Director Wu Tang impeached him for feigning madness; he was dismissed, escorted home, and his salt capital and land were confiscated;

sentences.zh: 存銀二萬五千兩儲湖北官庫，分年付貲生計，毋令失所，俟其病痊奏聞。

translations.literal: Twenty-five thousand taels of silver were kept in the Hubei government treasury and paid out year by year for a livelihood so he should not be left destitute; when his illness was cured this would be reported.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-five thousand taels were kept in the Hubei treasury and paid out year by year for his support so he would not be left destitute; when he recovered, this was to be reported.

sentences.zh: 既而病痊，疆吏張之萬、譚廷襄等交章論薦，召至京，予頭等侍衛。

translations.literal: Before long he recovered; frontier officials Zhang Zhiwan, Tan Tingxiang, and others memorialized recommending him in turn; he was summoned to the capital and granted the rank of First Class Imperial Bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he recovered; frontier officials including Zhang Zhiwan and Tan Tingxiang memorialized in his favor; he was summoned to the capital and made a First Class Imperial Bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 六年春，捻匪張總愚猝犯畿南，命率師迎擊。

translations.literal: In the spring of the sixth year Nian chief Zhang Zongyu suddenly attacked south of the capital region; he was ordered to lead troops to meet the attack.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the sixth year Nian chief Zhang Zongyu suddenly raided south of the capital; he was ordered to lead troops against him.

sentences.zh: 國瑞兩晝夜馳抵保定，詔嘉之。

translations.literal: Guorui reached Baoding in two days and two nights; an edict praised him.
translations.idiomatic: Guorui reached Baoding in two days and two nights, and an edict praised his speed.

sentences.zh: 數敗賊，追至河南境。

translations.literal: He defeated the rebels several times and pursued them to Henan territory.
translations.idiomatic: He defeated the rebels several times and pursued them into Henan.

sentences.zh: 行軍輒自由，不聽節制，所部尤無紀律，屢被彈劾。

translations.literal: On campaign he always acted as he pleased and would not obey command; his troops especially had no discipline and he was repeatedly impeached.
translations.idiomatic: On campaign he always did as he pleased and ignored orders; his troops were especially undisciplined, and he was impeached repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 擊賊於濟陽、德平，皆捷。

translations.literal: Attacking rebels at Jiyang and Deping, he won in each case.
translations.idiomatic: He attacked rebels at Jiyang and Deping and won both engagements.

sentences.zh: 洎捻平，悉復原職、黃馬褂、勇號，予雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: When the Nian were pacified, all his original offices, yellow riding jacket, and brave-title were restored, and he was granted the hereditary office of Cloud Cavalry Captain.
translations.idiomatic: When the Nian were suppressed, all his former offices, yellow riding jacket, and brave-title were restored, and he was granted the hereditary rank of Cloud Cavalry Captain.

sentences.zh: 以傷發，乞假居揚州。

translations.literal: Because his wounds reopened he requested leave and lived at Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: His old wounds reopened; he asked for leave and settled at Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 李世忠與有嫌，相閧，世忠縛諸舟，將斃之。

translations.literal: Li Shizhong bore him a grudge; they quarreled; Shizhong bound him to a boat and was about to kill him.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shizhong bore him a grudge; they quarreled, and Shizhong had him bound to a boat and was about to kill him.

sentences.zh: 曾國籓劾世忠，革職，國瑞降都司，勒令回籍。

translations.literal: Zeng Guofan impeached Shizhong and had him dismissed; Guorui was reduced to battalion commander and ordered to return to his native place.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan impeached Shizhong and had him dismissed; Guorui was demoted to battalion commander and ordered home.

sentences.zh: 國瑞复潛至揚州，因總兵詹啟綸毆斃胡士禮獄，牽連論罪，戍黑龍江。

translations.literal: Guorui again slipped into Yangzhou; because regional commander Zhan Qilun beat Hu Shili to death in prison, he was implicated and sentenced, and was sent into exile in Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Guorui slipped back to Yangzhou; implicated in regional commander Zhan Qilun's beating of Hu Shili to death in prison, he was sentenced and exiled to Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 逾數年，朝廷猶念舊功，以詢大學士李鴻章，鴻章謂其情性未改，精力已衰，遂不復用。

translations.literal: After several years the court still remembered his past merit and consulted Grand Secretary Li Hongzhang; Hongzhang said his temperament had not changed and his vigor had already waned, so he was not employed again.
translations.idiomatic: Several years later the court still remembered his past service and consulted Grand Secretary Li Hongzhang, who said his temperament had not changed and his strength had faded; he was not employed again.

sentences.zh: 光緒八年，歿於戍所。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Guangxu he died at his place of exile.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Guangxu he died in exile.

sentences.zh: 給事中鄧承修、山東巡撫福潤、安徽巡撫沈秉成、湖廣總督張之洞先後疏陳戰績，詔允复官，並於立功諸省建專祠。

translations.literal: Censor Deng Chengxu, Shandong governor Fu Run, Anhui governor Shen Bingcheng, and Huguang governor Zhang Zhidong successively memorialized setting out his battle achievements; an edict granted restoration of rank and also ordered dedicated shrines built in the provinces where he had won merit.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Deng Chengxu, Shandong governor Fu Run, Anhui governor Shen Bingcheng, and Huguang governor Zhang Zhidong successively memorialized his battle record; an edict restored his rank and ordered dedicated shrines built in the provinces where he had served with distinction.

sentences.zh: 郭寶昌，安徽鳳陽人。

translations.literal: Guo Baochang was a native of Fengyang in Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Baochang came from Fengyang in Anhui.

sentences.zh: 投效臨淮軍中，從戰數有功。

translations.literal: He offered his service in the Linhuai army and followed campaigns with repeated merit.
translations.idiomatic: He joined the Linhuai army and distinguished himself in repeated campaigns.

sentences.zh: 尋改隸陳國瑞楚勝軍。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was transferred to Chen Guorui's Chusheng Army.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to Chen Guorui's Chusheng Army.

sentences.zh: 咸豐十一年，國瑞擊捻匪於高郵、寶應，寶昌率驍健十八人為前鋒，陷陣得捷，又率兵三百破賊於天長龍崗，擢守備，賜花翎。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Xianfeng, when Guorui attacked Nian bandits at Gaoyou and Baoying, Baochang led eighteen stalwarts as vanguard, broke into the battle line and won, also led three hundred troops to defeat rebels at Longgang in Tianchang, was promoted to garrison commander, and was granted the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Xianfeng, when Guorui fought Nian bandits at Gaoyou and Baoying, Baochang led eighteen picked men as vanguard, broke through the enemy line and won, then led three hundred troops to defeat rebels at Longgang in Tianchang. He was promoted to garrison commander and granted the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 同治元年正月，捻酋李成、任柱等犯清江浦，楚勝軍御之，戰車橋鎮。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Tongzhi Nian chiefs Li Cheng, Ren Zhu, and others attacked Qingjiangpu; the Chusheng Army resisted them and fought at Cheqiao Town.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first year of Tongzhi, Nian chiefs including Li Cheng and Ren Zhu attacked Qingjiangpu; the Chusheng Army met them and fought at Cheqiao Town.

sentences.zh: 賊分眾劫淮關，寶昌追截，奪還所劫稅銀數万兩。

translations.literal: The rebels split their force to raid Huai Pass customs; Baochang pursued and intercepted them and recovered tens of thousands of taels of seized tax silver.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels divided their force to raid the Huai Pass customs station; Baochang pursued and cut them off, recovering tens of thousands of taels of plundered tax silver.

sentences.zh: 賊奔還眾興集，寶昌潛師夜襲，連破二十餘壘，賊引去，擢游擊，賜號卓勇巴圖魯。

translations.literal: The rebels fled back to Zhongxingji; Baochang moved troops secretly and attacked by night, storming more than twenty camps in succession; the rebels withdrew; he was promoted to brigade general and granted the title Zhuoyong Batu'eru.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled back to Zhongxingji. Baochang moved his troops in secret and struck by night, storming more than twenty camps in succession until the enemy withdrew. He was promoted to brigade general and granted the title Zhuoyong Batu'eru.

sentences.zh: 捻黨劉添福等糾餘匪擾泗洲，山東棍匪亦響應，寶昌連破之汊河、沙浦莊，匪勢漸衰。

translations.literal: Nian partisans Liu Tianfu and others gathered remnant bandits to harass Sizhou; Shandong club-bandits also responded; Baochang defeated them in succession at Chahe and Shapuzhuang, and bandit strength gradually waned.
translations.idiomatic: Nian partisans led by Liu Tianfu rallied remnant bandits to harass Sizhou, and Shandong club-bandits answered their call. Baochang defeated them in turn at Chahe and Shapuzhuang, and the bandits' strength gradually faded.

sentences.zh: 二年，匪首孫化祥就擒。

translations.literal: In the second year the bandit chief Sun Huaxiang was captured.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year the bandit chief Sun Huaxiang was taken.

sentences.zh: 積功洊擢副將，楚勝軍名益著。

translations.literal: For accumulated merit he was repeatedly promoted to deputy commander, and the Chusheng Army's reputation grew ever greater.
translations.idiomatic: For repeated merit he was promoted again and again to deputy commander, and the Chusheng Army's fame grew ever greater.

sentences.zh: 僧格林沁調令助剿白蓮池、鳳凰山，從陳國瑞迭出奇兵力戰，生擒賊首劉雙印，斬其黨劉金春等於陣。

translations.literal: Senggelinqin ordered him to assist in suppressing White Lotus Pool and Fenghuang Mountain; following Chen Guorui he repeatedly sent out surprise forces and fought fiercely, capturing rebel chief Liu Shuangyin alive and executing his followers Liu Jinchun and others on the battlefield.
translations.idiomatic: Senggelinqin ordered him to help suppress White Lotus Pool and Fenghuang Mountain. Serving under Chen Guorui, he again and again sent out surprise detachments and fought hard, taking the rebel chief Liu Shuangyin alive and cutting down Liu Jinchun and other followers in battle.

sentences.zh: 任柱糾棍匪、教​​匪諸黨來援，並擊走之。

translations.literal: Ren Zhu gathered club-bandits, sect rebels, and various factions to come to the rescue, and Baochang beat them all back.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Zhu rallied club-bandits, sect rebels, and other factions to the rescue, but Baochang drove them all off.

sentences.zh: 白蓮池平，論功，以總兵記名。

translations.literal: White Lotus Pool was pacified; for merit he was registered for promotion as regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: When White Lotus Pool was pacified, his merit earned him registration for promotion to regional commander.

sentences.zh: 移軍剿苗沛霖。

translations.literal: He moved his army to suppress Miao Peilin.
translations.idiomatic: He shifted his army to suppress Miao Peilin.

sentences.zh: 寶昌偕陳國瑞先至，攻破王家圩，渡河築三壘，與賊對峙，斷其餽運。

translations.literal: Baochang arrived first together with Chen Guorui, stormed Wangjia Stockade, crossed the river and built three forts, confronted the rebels, and cut off their supply lines.
translations.idiomatic: Baochang and Chen Guorui arrived first, stormed Wangjia Stockade, crossed the river and built three forts, held the rebels at bay, and severed their supply lines.

sentences.zh: 賊悉銳來爭，擊卻之，賊氣奪。

translations.literal: The rebels mustered all their best troops to contest it; he repulsed them and their spirit was broken.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels threw their best troops into the fight; he beat them back and broke their morale.

sentences.zh: 大軍至，諸圩以次下，沛霖走死，加提督銜。

translations.literal: The main army arrived; the stockades fell one by one; Peilin fled and died; he was given the rank of provincial commander.
translations.idiomatic: When the main army arrived the stockades fell one after another, Peilin fled to his death, and Baochang was given the rank of provincial commander.

sentences.zh: 三年，調援湖北，與陳國瑞分軍，名曰卓勝營，始獨當一面。

translations.literal: In the third year he was transferred to reinforce Hubei; he and Chen Guorui divided their forces into what was called the Zhuosheng Camp, and for the first time he held an independent command.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was sent to reinforce Hubei. He and Chen Guorui split their forces into the Zhuosheng Camp, and for the first time Baochang held an independent command.

sentences.zh: 八月，粵、捻諸匪由湖北入安徽，至英山東北，寶昌合諸軍敗之黑石渡。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Cantonese and Nian bandits entered Anhui from Hubei and reached northeast of Yingshan; Baochang joined the armies and defeated them at Heishidu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Cantonese rebels and Nian bandits entered Anhui from Hubei and reached the northeast of Yingshan; Baochang combined with the other armies and defeated them at Heishidu.

sentences.zh: 賊首馬融和擁眾十萬，議投誠，未決。

translations.literal: Rebel chief Ma Ronghe held a following of one hundred thousand and deliberated surrender, but had not decided.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel chief Ma Ronghe commanded a force of one hundred thousand and debated surrender, but had not yet made up his mind.

sentences.zh: 寶昌單騎入其營，曉譬禍福，融和即日降。

translations.literal: Baochang rode alone into his camp, explained the blessings and calamities, and Ronghe surrendered the same day.
translations.idiomatic: Baochang rode alone into the camp, explained the rewards and risks of each course, and Ronghe surrendered that same day.

sentences.zh: 事聞，賜黃馬褂。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, he was granted a yellow riding jacket.
translations.idiomatic: When the report reached the court, he was granted a yellow riding jacket.

sentences.zh: 四年，從僧格林沁轉戰楚、豫之交，功多，特奏保提督記名。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he campaigned with Senggelinqin back and forth at the border of Chu and Yu; his merit was great, and he was specially memorialized and registered for promotion to provincial commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he campaigned with Senggelinqin back and forth on the Hubei-Henan border. His merit was considerable, and he was specially recommended and registered for promotion to provincial commander.

sentences.zh: 尋以曹州之敗，詔斥不能救護主將，革職遣戍新疆。

translations.literal: Soon afterward, because of the defeat at Caozhou, an edict rebuked him for failing to protect the commander-in-chief; he was dismissed from office and sent into exile in Xinjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, after the defeat at Caozhou, an edict rebuked him for failing to protect his commander; he was stripped of office and banished to Xinjiang.

sentences.zh: 五年，曾國籓、喬松年奏請免發遣，留營效力。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Zeng Guofan and Qiao Songnian memorialized requesting exemption from banishment, that he remain with the army to serve.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Zeng Guofan and Qiao Songnian memorialized asking that he be spared banishment and kept with the army to serve.

sentences.zh: 六年，從喬松年赴陝西，偕提督劉松山剿回匪於臨平，克之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he followed Qiao Songnian to Shaanxi and together with provincial commander Liu Songshan suppressed Muslim rebels at Linping and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he followed Qiao Songnian to Shaanxi and, together with provincial commander Liu Songshan, suppressed Muslim rebels at Linping and took the place.

sentences.zh: 捻魁張總愚率眾萬餘犯富平，寶昌縱間伺隙出奇襲之。

translations.literal: Nian chief Zhang Zongyu led more than ten thousand men to attack Fuping; Baochang used spies, watched for openings, and struck with a surprise attack.
translations.idiomatic: The Nian chief Zhang Zongyu led more than ten thousand men against Fuping; Baochang sent out spies, watched for an opening, and struck with a surprise attack.

sentences.zh: 令部將宋朝儒等設伏村墟，自率親軍挑戰，伏起夾擊，斬馘數千，又敗賊於大荔大濠，復原官、勇號。

translations.literal: He ordered his subordinate officers Song Chaoru and others to set an ambush in a village hamlet; he personally led his personal guard to provoke battle; the ambush rose and attacked from both sides, slaying several thousand; he again defeated rebels at Dali Daohao, and his original rank and brave-title were restored.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered his officers Song Chaoru and others to lie in ambush in a village hamlet while he personally led his guard to provoke battle. When the ambush sprang up and struck from both sides, several thousand were killed. He defeated the rebels again at Dali Daohao, and his original rank and brave-title were restored.

sentences.zh: 進复綏德州，授安徽壽春鎮總兵。

translations.literal: Advancing, he recovered Suide Prefecture and was appointed commander-in-chief of the Shouchun garrison in Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing forward, he recovered Suide Prefecture and was appointed commander-in-chief of the Shouchun garrison in Anhui.

sentences.zh: 七年春，捻匪由山西、河南直犯畿輔，寶昌馳援，日行百餘裡，抄出賊前抵保定。

translations.literal: In the spring of the seventh year Nian bandits from Shanxi and Henan struck straight at the metropolitan region; Baochang hurried to the relief, covering more than a hundred li a day, cut ahead of the rebels and reached Baoding.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the seventh year Nian bandits from Shanxi and Henan marched straight on the capital region. Baochang raced to the relief, covering more than a hundred li a day, cut ahead of the enemy, and reached Baoding.

sentences.zh: 賊至，見官軍盛，引去，晉號法凌阿巴圖魯。

translations.literal: When the rebels arrived and saw the government troops in strength, they withdrew; he was advanced to the title Falin'a Batu'eru.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels arrived and saw the government force in strength, they withdrew. Baochang was advanced to the title Falin'a Batu'eru.

sentences.zh: 躡賊入河南，敗之封丘、黃河套。

translations.literal: Pursuing the rebels into Henan, he defeated them at Fengqiu and at the Yellow River bend.
translations.idiomatic: Pursuing the rebels into Henan, he defeated them at Fengqiu and in the Yellow River bend.

sentences.zh: 張總愚匿村舍中，寶昌單騎獨出，突遇賊，受傷墮馬，部將宋朝儒翼之出。

translations.literal: Zhang Zongyu hid in a village dwelling; Baochang rode out alone, suddenly encountered rebels, was wounded and fell from his horse; his subordinate officer Song Chaoru shielded him and brought him out.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zongyu hid in a village house. Baochang rode out alone, suddenly ran into rebels, was wounded and thrown from his horse, and his officer Song Chaoru shielded him and brought him out.

sentences.zh: 事聞，予假兩月調理，賜尚方珍藥。

translations.literal: When this was reported, he was granted two months' leave to recover and given precious medicine from the imperial pharmacy.
translations.idiomatic: When the report reached the court, he was granted two months' leave to recover and given precious medicine from the imperial pharmacy.

sentences.zh: 未幾，捻匪平，复黃馬褂，以提督簡放，予騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: Before long the Nian bandits were pacified; his yellow riding jacket was restored; he was selected for appointment as provincial commander; and he was granted a hereditary rank as Cavalry Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the Nian were pacified. His yellow riding jacket was restored, he was selected for appointment as provincial commander, and he was granted the hereditary rank of Cavalry Commandant.

sentences.zh: 命從左宗棠赴陝西剿回匪。

translations.literal: He was ordered to follow Zuo Zongtang to Shaanxi to suppress Muslim rebels.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to follow Zuo Zongtang to Shaanxi to suppress Muslim rebels.

sentences.zh: 八年，傷愈，西行，破賊於宜川，平綏德州叛卒。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, his wounds healed, he went west, defeated rebels at Yichuan, and pacified the mutinous troops at Suide Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, once his wounds had healed, he went west, defeated rebels at Yichuan, and pacified the mutinous garrison at Suide Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 回匪東趨，命赴山西防河。

translations.literal: When Muslim rebels moved east, he was ordered to go to Shanxi to guard the river.
translations.idiomatic: When Muslim rebels moved eastward, he was ordered to Shanxi to guard the river.

sentences.zh: 九年，河西土匪起，寶昌渡河擊破其眾。

translations.literal: In the ninth year bandits rose west of the river; Baochang crossed the river and defeated their force.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year bandits rose west of the river; Baochang crossed over and broke their force.

sentences.zh: 奉檄搜捕北山土匪，悉平。

translations.literal: Receiving orders to search out and capture bandits in the northern hills, he pacified them all.
translations.idiomatic: Ordered to hunt down bandits in the northern hills, he pacified them all.

sentences.zh: 十年，赴壽春鎮任。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he took up his post at the Shouchun garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he took up his post at the Shouchun garrison.

sentences.zh: 十一年，霍丘蔡家集土匪李六倡亂，率輕騎百人往剿，誅渠魁而還。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year the bandit Li Liu of Caijiaji in Huoqiu raised a rebellion; Baochang led a hundred light cavalry to suppress them, executed the ringleaders, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year the bandit Li Liu of Caijiaji in Huoqiu raised a revolt. Baochang led a hundred light cavalry to suppress it, executed the ringleaders, and returned.

sentences.zh: 事定，加頭品頂戴。

translations.literal: When the affair was settled, he was granted the first-rank cap button.
translations.idiomatic: When the affair was settled, he was granted the first-rank cap button.

sentences.zh: 光緒二年，平永城、渦陽土匪，被優敘。

translations.literal: In the second year of Guangxu he pacified bandits at Yongcheng and Woyang and received preferential commendation.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Guangxu he pacified bandits at Yongcheng and Woyang and received preferential commendation.

sentences.zh: 寶昌剿捻功最多，鎮壽春先後三十年，淮北恃為保障。

translations.literal: Baochang's merit in suppressing the Nian was the greatest; he garrisoned Shouchun on and off for thirty years, and northern Huai relied on him as a bulwark.
translations.idiomatic: Baochang's merit against the Nian was the greatest of all; he held Shouchun on and off for thirty years, and northern Huai looked to him as its shield.

sentences.zh: 調廣東南韶鎮，未任，尋還故官。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the Nanshao garrison in Guangdong but never took up the post; soon afterward he returned to his former office.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to the Nanshao garrison in Guangdong but never took up the post; soon afterward he returned to his former command.

sentences.zh: 俄羅斯、法蘭西、日本三次開兵釁，調防南北，事定仍回本任。

translations.literal: Russia, France, and Japan on three occasions opened hostilities; he was transferred to defend north and south, and when affairs were settled he returned to his original post.
translations.idiomatic: When Russia, France, and Japan opened hostilities on three separate occasions, he was shifted to defend north and south; when each crisis passed he returned to his original post.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，卒於官，賜卹。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year he died in office and was granted a condolence pension.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year he died in office and was granted a condolence pension.

sentences.zh: 論曰：秦定三、鄭魁士並向榮得力之將，和春克廬州，悉賴二人，遂與皖事終始。

translations.literal: The commentators say: Qin Dingsan and Zheng Kuishi were both able generals under Xiang Rong; Hechun's capture of Luzhou depended entirely on the two of them, and thus they were tied to Anhui affairs from beginning to end.
translations.idiomatic: The commentators say: Qin Dingsan and Zheng Kuishi were both able generals under Xiang Rong. Hechun's capture of Luzhou depended entirely on the two of them, and so they were bound up with Anhui affairs from first to last.

sentences.zh: 桐城之潰，由於爭餉不和，亦疆臣無調度之方以致之。

translations.literal: The collapse at Tongcheng arose from disputes over rations and lack of harmony, and also from frontier officials' failure to coordinate—a lack of method in deployment that brought it about.
translations.idiomatic: The collapse at Tongcheng came of quarrels over supplies and mutual ill will, and also of frontier officials' failure to coordinate—a want of command that brought disaster.

sentences.zh: 傅振邦老於軍事，持重無失。

translations.literal: Fu Zhenbang was old in military affairs, steady and without misstep.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Zhenbang was a veteran of war, steady and never at fault.

sentences.zh: 邱聯恩名將之子，在豫軍中最號忠勇。

translations.literal: Qiu Lian'en was the son of a famous general and was renowned in the Henan army above all for loyalty and courage.
translations.idiomatic: Qiu Lian'en was the son of a famous general and was famed in the Henan army above all for loyalty and courage.

sentences.zh: 陳國瑞勇足冠軍，剽悍不受繩尺，不能以功名終。

translations.literal: Chen Guorui's courage topped the army, but he was fierce and unrestrained, accepting no discipline, and could not finish his career with official honor intact.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Guorui's courage topped the army, but he was fierce and wild, accepting no restraint, and could not end his career with honor intact.

sentences.zh: 郭寶昌戰績亦與並稱，材武不及，而器量差勝焉。

translations.literal: Guo Baochang's battle record was likewise celebrated alongside the others; in talent and martial prowess he fell short, yet in breadth of character he was somewhat the better.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Baochang's battle record stood with the best of them; in talent and martial prowess he fell short, but in breadth of character he was somewhat the better.
